title: A gauge-potential cross term exactly exchanges the lifted electric-current leakage

normal_form_exchange.gauge_convention: In temporal gauge fix E=-partial_t A and retain K1413's lifted current j_n^a=e Im<Q^(n+1)phi,D^aQ^n phi>
normal_form_exchange.cross_term: Define M_n(t)=int_T3 A(t,x) dot j_n(t,x) dx
normal_form_exchange.product_rule: M_n'=-int E dot j_n dx+int A dot partial_t j_n dx
normal_form_exchange.corrected_identity: For G_n=F_n^PDE+M_n, K1413 gives G_n'=(lambda/2)int partial_t||phi||^2||Q^n phi||^2 dx+int A dot partial_t j_n dx
normal_form_exchange.current_derivative: partial_t j_n is the sum of e Im<Q^(n+1)pi,DQ^n phi>, e Im<Q^(n+1)phi,DQ^n pi> and e Im<Q^(n+1)phi,(partial_t D)Q^n phi>; it therefore introduces differentiated matter and gauge-field terms
normal_form_exchange.k1478_escape: On K1478's Gauss-compatible witness A=0 at the testing time, M_n=0 but M_n'=-int E dot j_n, so the gauge-dependent correction exactly cancels the live leakage that defeats every ultralocal matter-density correction
normal_form_exchange.new_boundary: The electric-current work is exchanged, not eliminated: same-tier coercivity of M_n, control of int A dot partial_t j_n, the pointwise radial leakage, charge summation and global Cauchy closure remain open
normal_form_exchange.scope_guard: This is an exact first normal-form/product-rule step in one fixed gauge, not a gauge-invariant energy, same-tier estimate, closed modified energy or completed full PDE flow
